title: ...start running as a beginner or C25K participant
desc: Build cardiovascular endurance safely without joint pain or injury.
todos: Get fitted for proper supportive running shoes at local specialty running shop.
Incorporate dynamic mobility stretches before runs (leg swings, walking lunges).
Follow walk-run interval method rather than sprinting continuously.
Maintain comfortable conversational pace where you can speak in full sentences.
Schedule rest or low-impact cross-training days between running sessions.
